description: Block git commits if tests fail — run npm test before allowing commit

PreToolUse.command: INPUT=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '^git\s+commit'; then echo 'Running tests before commit...' && npm test --silent 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Tests failed. Fix tests before committing.' && exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json. This ensures all tests pass before any git commit is allowed. Customize 'npm test' to your test command.
